candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method defaultModel to class Select
candidates.description:
Move method defaultModel to org.apache.tapestry5.corelib.components.Select
Rationale: The defaultModel method is closely related to the Select class as it deals with the selection of models based on the type of values in a select component. This method determines how to create a SelectModel for a given Select instance, specifically focusing on Enum types. Moving it to the Select class makes sense because it enhances the encapsulation of select-related logic and aligns with the purpose of the class, which is to manage selection of items from a list of values.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method beginRender to class Field
candidates.description:
Move method beginRender to org.apache.tapestry5.Field
Rationale: The method beginRender(MarkupWriter writer) is responsible for determining whether to add a 'disabled' attribute to the markup based on the state of the field. Since the 'isDisabled()' method is part of the Field interface, it makes logical sense for beginRender to reside within the Field class. This encapsulation aligns the rendering logic directly with the field's properties, promoting better cohesion. Moving the method to Field will also enhance the clarity of the code, as it will be evident that rendering behavior is closely tied to the field's state.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method buildComponentRequestHandler to class TapestryModule

Moving this method to TapestryModule will enhance cohesion, as it directly relates to the module's purpose of managing and configuring components and their requests.
